text.title: Redmarsh Border
text.body: Beyond the old border stone lies the Redmarsh, a rusted basin of reed beds and sunken fords. Raider scouts hold the crossings and watch the northern road. Cross into the borderland and drive out every scout pack.
text.obj.0: Cross into the northern Redmarsh borderland
text.obj.1: Sunder the Three Raider Reconnaissance Wings
text.msg.1: Two fords cross the stream ahead. Keep shields in front and watch the marsh grass.
text.msg.2: We have crossed into the borderland, and shapes are rising from the reeds!
text.msg.3: All three raider reconnaissance wings are broken in the mire. Abandoned beneath the shattered toll gate lies an iron courier coffer of recovered coins.
text.msg.4: The borderland is ours. Ahead rise the twin spurs of the Ironback range—and in Redmarsh Outpost, Tomb-Notary Seti studies the southern audit seal on Morvessa's Signet Ring with cautious respect before clearing our passage.
text.win: The Redmarsh border is secure and the mountain road lies open.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen on the Redmarsh border.
